rejection_summary: Land of Sin / Synden (2026, tt33501959): revelation-cadence failure for this profile. The five-episode murder investigation contains substantial police work and eventually uncovers the generational family conflict, but the available whole-season evidence shows much of the decisive causal explanation concentrated late: Oliver is implicated and arrested while Dani continues working the case, and the finale supplies the Jon/Katty mechanism and cover-up. Investigation volume is therefore stronger than the frequency of meaningful reframing, and the title was not promoted by treating procedural activity as revelation cadence.
